purpose: Explicit local review selection only. Does not apply, merge, approve, resolve, delete, or authorize any decision or operational action.

reviewContext.meaning: Optional user-written review context only. Not approval, authentication, authorization, or a change to any source fact.

selectionMeaning: Only the listed records were explicitly selected. Omitted records are not implicitly approved, rejected, or resolved. Missing incoming snapshots are absence, not deletion instructions.

comparison.fingerprintMeaning: SHA-256 measured over the exact loaded comparison file bytes, not a declared source hash. Identifies bytes only; not authenticity, integrity against a trusted source, shared history, or authorization.

scopeMessage: Only the explicitly selected records are requested for review.
notices: Review request only: does not apply, merge, approve, resolve, delete, or authorize any decision or operational action.
Unselected records are outside the requested scope; omission is not implicit approval, rejection, or resolution.
An absent incoming snapshot is absence, not a deletion instruction. No snapshot is synthesized.
The measured fingerprint identifies only the supplied comparison bytes; not authenticity, trusted-source integrity, shared history, or authorization.
Evidence hashes, paths, dates and sizes are unverified source claims; referenced evidence is never opened or fetched.
Current and incoming are report sides, not proven chronological before/after states. Revisions and timestamps do not establish precedence or a winner.

reportContext.matchBasis: exact workspace and groupKey only; not source identity or lineage
limitations: Review report only: never applies, merges, or authorizes decisions or operational actions.
Declared evidence hashes, paths, sizes, and dates are unverified claims; referenced evidence is never opened or fetched.
Matching hashes do not prove source identity, integrity, shared history, or authorization.
Revision numbers and timestamps are reported independently, not used to infer lineage, precedence, or a winner.
A groupKey match is only a candidate correspondence; changed evidence may describe different underlying events.

records.reviewRequest: Review the supplied current and incoming facts for this selected record; absent sides remain absent.

current.note: Request the original dispatch log to confirm whether and when this order was dispatched. Missing timestamps mean the dispatch status is unknown.

incoming.note: Request the original dispatch log and carrier handover receipt. Until both are checked, missing timestamps leave dispatch status unknown.

changes.current: Request the original dispatch log to confirm whether and when this order was dispatched. Missing timestamps mean the dispatch status is unknown.
changes.incoming: Request the original dispatch log and carrier handover receipt. Until both are checked, missing timestamps leave dispatch status unknown.

records.reviewRequest: Review the supplied current and incoming facts for this selected record; absent sides remain absent.
